**Identifying white animals in cold regions**

I’m trying to think about which animals are white and related to snowy environments. I’m considering big animals like polar bears. They definitely fit the description of being white and living in cold, snowy areas. An arctic fox could also work, right? Maybe I'm even thinking about a snowy owl, but isn’t that more about being high up? I think I’ll stick with polar bears and maybe add the arctic fox as a good candidate.
